messages.subject: Error install dev branch
parts:

messages.author: dc06d729e023580a
messages.subject: Re: Error install dev branch
parts:
You need to restart following the install of the updated devtools, and
use the correct roxygen repo: install_github("roxygen", "klutometis")

Hadley
